notes.title: The official version is coming. Join the photographer
notes.notes:
Everyone, with the support of the majority of players, the photographer successfully ended EA.

In the new version, scenes, props and sound effects are added according to the feedback of players.

The complete version is added as follows:

[olist]

 add skin color setting function

 add main light direction and color setting function

 add dynamic cloth test

 add 8 clothes

 add 3 scenes

 add default color

 Steamworks support

[/olist]

Thank you

notes.title: Player feedback update v1
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone. The photographer has been well received after the release. I feel very honored.
According to your comments, I will gradually update and improve the photographer.
Some of the contents of this open update are as follows:
[olist]
 add skin color setting 
 add the main light direction and color setting
 add dynamic cloth test
 adjusted item generation position
[/olist]
Thank you again for your support. I hope you can leave more messages.
